calibration.boxcar_applied_to: all three coherency elements, before Stokes

sign_convention: S3 = -2 Im<E_H E_V*> (physical reading); SC = (S0-S3)/2, OC = (S0+S3)/2; the other sign gives CPR -> 1/CPR

results.t3b_band: [c, 1/c], c = ((sqrt l_H - sqrt l_V)/(sqrt l_H + sqrt l_V))^2 = CPR_a; follows from |S3| <= 2 sqrt(l_H l_V) (Cauchy-Schwarz) and is invariant to any phase rotation

sign.reasoning: CPR = (S0-S3)/(S0+S3) with S3 = +/-2 Im<E_H E_V*> admits one binary choice: which circular combination is same-sense. CPR is defined so that single-bounce reflection, which reverses handedness, gives CPR < 1. A frame-wide median of 3.84 would make the south pole double-bounce everywhere against every published map; the reading with median 0.2602 is physical.

phase_evidence.reading: consistency check on the scene-mean phase under the single-bounce quadrature assumption; scene and instrument phase are confounded without a calibration target

withdrawn_reading.text: the residual phase-calibration error is BOUNDED by the data at < 2 deg; this is calibration evidence, not an ambiguity
withdrawn_reading.why: review item M12: the scene-mean phase equals the instrumental offset only if the scene is exactly single-bounce quadrature; without a calibration target the two cannot be separated

diagnostic_rotations_not_admissible.why: 90/270 mistake S2 for S3; 45/135/315 mix them. Not readings.

invariant.window_selection: 20 non-overlapping 15x15 windows wholly inside the mask, lowest CV of S0 on the SLC grid -- the criterion of cpr_dispersion.py, Sec. V-C

definitions.gamma_c: circular-channel FIELD coherence |<E_SC E_OC*>| / sqrt(<|E_SC|^2><|E_OC|^2>) = sqrt(S1^2 + S2^2) / sqrt(S0^2 - S3^2), per cell, from the same boxcar'd coherency matrix as the DOP

identity.consequence: gamma_c <= DOP, so the gate forces gamma_c < 0.13

joint_measured.not_comparable_to: joint_criterion.py simulates a 0.7 background; this is the rate on the terrain actually observed

t3e.design: empirical Stokes CPR about each window's median vs F(2N_SC, 2N_OC) at the window's own moment ENLs; ratio > 1 = heavier tail than F (residual texture), < 1 = narrower (channel correlation). Whole-frame quantiles were the first version's error: they include terrain.

blocks_64x64.key_name_note: the key keeps its 64x64 name so consumers address one path; block_px is the size used

coherence_predicts_cpr.predicted: (1 - rho)/(1 + rho), rho = the window's median H-V coherence
coherence_predicts_cpr.observed: the window's median Stokes CPR (physical sign)

tail_calibration.estimation: median CPR and N_SC, N_OC (moment ENL, ddof = 1) are estimated on one half of each 64x64 block and the tail is read on the other half, two folds pooled; the in-sample ratios of blocks_64x64 use the same cells for both

t3a.status: partial - distributional, at matched ENL; no per-cell slope or r^2 without geocoding
t3a.blocker: slant-range vs selenoreferenced grid; per-cell regression needs a geocoding step whose own error would dominate the residual
